caption: The drawing depicts a wooden table with three rectangular legs joined by horizontal supports. The tabletop is uneven and shows visible wood grain and wear, with brown and beige tones used to indicate the natural color and texture of the wood. Resting on the table's surface is a round, shallow bowl, shaded in gray to off-white, suggesting a stone or ceramic texture. In the upper left corner, there is a small, black line drawing of a metallic latch or lock. In the upper right corner, another small rectangular sketch shows a cross-section of a plank of wood, highlighting details of its grain and surface cracks. The drawing is set against a plain, off-white background with a thin, hand-drawn border.
title: Trestle Table
